items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: She played for Sunday South, and I was playing, I was playing at her place with Celestan.

ctx.x: You said you switched jobs with- Yeah, we swapped.

She played for Sunday South, and I was playing, I was playing at her place with Celestan. You traveled all over the South? Right, Florida, Texas, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia. We went all through Arkansas, but I took sick at the time, I couldn't go with them. You bought the piece on one of them. I think it was at that time.
Now back to- What part did Kildee play on trumpet? Was he second or third?
